summary.text: Kim Dailey is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 85, in the November 3, 2026 general election; she won the June 2, 2026 Republican primary over Michele Binkley and faces Democrat Laura Jackson in a race with no incumbent.

paragraphs.text: Kim Dailey ran in the June 4, 2024 Republican primary for Montana House of Representatives District 88, where she lost to Greg Overstreet, 54.2 percent to 45.8 percent.
In 2026 she defeated Michele Binkley in the District 85 Republican primary, 57.0 percent to 43.0 percent, and Ballotpedia lists an endorsement from Americans for Prosperity - Montana.
